notes: Underground nuclear test sites where a test remains physically possible. Closed and dismantled sites (Semipalatinsk, closed 1991; Mururoa and Fangataufa, dismantled 1998) are left out: they add false-alarm area and no detection. A test at a site not listed here is caught only when USGS itself classifies it. Base rates in scripts/detect_cbrn_notices.js were measured against the USGS catalogue on 19 Sept 2026: M>=3.5 within 50 km of these sites since 2000. `quiet` marks a site with no independent natural earthquake of M>=3.5 in that record (Punggye-ri has one, induced by the 2017 test); Lop Nur, Nevada, Ras Koh and Kharan are seismically active.
